## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; confirmation: extremely weak sector breadth (only Energy positive) and pronounced leadership concentration in Tech winners vs widespread sector weakness; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5). 

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.07%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND, Energy 1W: +0.17% (sole positive sector). Technology shows top-stock leadership despite sector weakness: INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare, Communication and Consumer Discretionary are the weakest: NVS (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.12% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION, SBUX (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -6.44%) BELOW TREND; sector-level weakness is broad (10/11 sectors negative).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +9.32%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NVS (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.51% | 1M: -22.44%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -18.10%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -10.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Healthcare and Consumer/Comm names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap names (NVDA, V, MA, JNJ) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with narrow leadership and overall sector weakness: AAPL (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +7.10%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -2.07%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -0.11% (majority of names under pressure despite a few leaders).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Drift lower and internally weak: JPM (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.34%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier; Financials 1W: -0.95% with limited leadership and mixed signals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Broadly weak and under pressure: UNH (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -3.46%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -7.44%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare 1W: -5.30% and showing sector-level weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to the narrow Tech leaders (INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND) and defend with Energy (XOM (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.07%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to broad Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary where multiple names are BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth and concentrated outperformance.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — bullish news confirms price; AMAT (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -13.53%) RECOVERY — news-driven momentum; META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND; AMGN (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND) as the lone positive sector — monitor for follow-through. BEARISH: Healthcare and Materials showing broad 1W weakness and risk of further underperformance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.51% (CORRECTION) — watch for break below near-term support as trigger for wider Tech pullback; AAPL 1W: +0.50% | 1M: +7.10% (ABOVE TREND) — sustained hold would support broader market; INTC 1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67% (ABOVE TREND) — follow-through or reversal will signal whether narrow leadership expands.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (+60): Oracle (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — news (record cloud revenue) confirming price strength. AMAT (+60): Applied Materials (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -13.53%) RECOVERY — positive AI demand headlines supporting a short-term bounce. JPM (+60): JPMorgan (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.34%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines diverging from price, monitor for re-rating or fade.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVS (-50): Novartis (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND — news and price both confirm downside. INTC (-50): Intel (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND — analyst downgrade is diverging vs strong price action; watch for distribution. NFLX (-50): Netflix (1W: -8.12% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION — weak outlook headlines align with the sharp 1W drop.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech winners and only one positive sector. INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) showing relative strength. Key risk is the narrow leadership (Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)) vs market breadth 1/11 positive and notable sentiment/price divergences (INTC negative headlines vs price; NVDA CORRECTION).
